device.description: 8-bit 2-channel SAR ADC with MICROWIRE serial interface and MUX addressing
device.note: adc08832.pdf (SNAS015C) p.2 connection diagram (Figure 2) and operating ratings, p.3-4 electrical and timing characteristics, p.9-10 timing diagrams (Figure 21), p.12 Table 2 MUX addressing, p.13 digital interface

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the MUX address (SGL/DIF, ODD/SIGN) shifted in after the start bit; no read-back, reset not documented

commands.name: Idle (no start bit)
commands.note: p.13 step 2: the start bit is the first logic 1 on DI; leading zeros are ignored

commands.name: Start + MUX address
commands.note: Table 2: SGL/DIF 1 = single-ended, ODD/SIGN selects CH0 (0) or CH1 (1) as the + input; Figure 21: a leading 0 for the MUX settling clock, D7..D0 MSB first, then D1..D7 LSB first (D0 shared), then DO low until CS rises

pages: p.2 (Figure 2 pinout, operating ratings VCC 4.5-6.0 V), p.3 (logic levels, VREF tied to VCC), p.4 (tSET-UP, tpd 250 ns, TRI-STATE 180 ns), p.10 (Figure 21), p.12 (Table 2), p.13 (digital interface steps 1-8)
notModeled: analog inputs and the single-ended / differential / polarity selection (stored only; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00); VREF is internally tied to VCC
conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clocks after the MUX address); not timed, the result is ready at once
DO is TRI-STATE until the MUX address is in (modeled as released bits until the start command); DI and DO may be tied together (single-wire use)
DI is ignored after the MUX address until CS rises; the model keeps matching start bits in the same CS-low transaction
clock frequency limits (10 kHz-2 MHz) and duty cycle; low-power mode while CS is high
variants: ADC08831 (same datasheet): one fixed differential input, VREF pin instead of DI, MSB-first data only
